lines.text: the Devil therefore it shall come to pass that whosoever will notbelieve in my words which am Jesus Christ which the Father shall cause himto bring forth unto the Gentiles & shall give unto him Power that he shall bring them forth unto the Gentiles it shall be done even as Moses
